mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at overcast skies with a temperature of 66 degrees at Verona City Hall, under a waning crescent moon.

City updates include phase two of the Aldi development and road construction starting the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns on Highway M. Additionally, the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture is now on display at Century School Park.
For events today, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market kicks off, and you can also catch trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Friday, September 4, a 34 year old Madison resident was booked into the Dane County jail following an investigation into a sexual assault of a child by a school staff member that took place in 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by for a treat.
